preparation: Test-only quiet pocket on a generated first floor, original Item/Heap instances and hidden initial levels; ordinary Warrior statistics preserved. Ambient actors/spawners/hazards/heaps are removed before measurement. No world mutation outside original public actions after preparation.
private_assertion_boundary: Completed public state_version only. Hidden names/classes/levels are used to verify nondisclosure and different actual payloads, never to select a cell, item, control or next action.

prior_failed_attempts.reason: All three stacks were picked up correctly; runner wrongly expected Gold to sink. Original dropsDownHeap is false for all three fixture items, so original Heap.drop order is ThrowingStone -> Gold -> Food. Corrected the expectation and reran the complete case.

heap_type_matrix.original_behavior: Only the top stack is displayed, each native pickup removes that stack; empty heap is destroyed.
Direct operation converts to HEAP and spends one turn when adjacent; no confirmation window.
Single positive-value item uses original WndTradeItem purchase window; Back can cancel. Other FOR_SALE arrangements use pickup.
No matching GoldenKey: native refusal without opening. Correct current-depth key is consumed in onOperateComplete; then HEAP. No confirmation window.
Current-depth CrystalKey is consumed on operation. Before opening the original description already reveals artifact/wand/ring category, not exact content or level.
Direct opening calls Wraith.spawnAround(hero.pos) in four cardinal directions, then HEAP.
Direct opening with bone effects, then HEAP. setHauntedIfCursed is a distinct conditional behavior.
Hero remains use the same native opening path and can be haunted if cursed. No confirmation window.

door_plan.note: Needs a separate real exit/boss-floor fixture, not an invented generic doorway.
Artifact-created lock is a special interaction, not a normal universal key or confirmation window.

limits: Only two named cases passed in this phase; pending implementations are not evidence.
The hidden-content contrast uses two same-looking boxes at different public cells in one isolated world, not a claim that every full-world pair is equivalent.
Opening reveals item names but does not identify equipment levels; levels +2/+4 remained private.
The quiet test arena is not a normal playthrough, generated-room or ambient-monster validation.
No screenshots, keyboard/mouse simulation, Computer Use or formal profiles were used.
